headline: Russia Strikes Kyiv as Ukraine Destroys Su-34 Bombers at Marinovka Airfield
subheadline: Geran-5 missiles hit Kyiv's Desnyansky district and Brovary as Ukrainian Neptune missiles destroyed Russian Su-34 bombers at Marinovka airfield in Volgograd.
lede: Russian forces launched a large-scale combined missile and drone attack on Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, with Geran-5 missiles striking Desnyansky district and Brovary while reactive Shahed drones penetrated Obolonsky district and Chabany. Ukrainian Neptune coastal missiles struck the Marinovka airfield in Volgograd region, destroying Russian Su-34 bombers used for glide bomb attacks. In the Middle East, Israeli airstrikes hit dozens of Hezbollah Radwan Force rockets and launchers at a training camp 25 kilometers north of the border in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley, while Iran experienced widespread missile launches, UAV activity, and air defense engagements across Kermanshah, Hormozgan, Fars, and Khuzestan provinces. A senior Hamas economic official was killed in an Israeli strike in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah.

sections.title: Russia Barrages Kyiv; Ukraine Destroys Marinovka Bombers
sections.body: Russian forces launched Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones against Kyiv's Desnyansky district, Brovary, Obolonsky district, and the Chabany area. A Russian Tu-160 strategic bomber relocated to Engels airbase for cruise missile loading while Tu-95MS bombers prepared for a massive missile strike. Ukrainian Neptune coastal missiles struck the Marinovka airfield in Volgograd region, destroying Su-34 bombers that drop glide bombs. President Zelensky warned that Russia is finalizing preparations for a new massive strike on energy, logistics, and life-support systems nationwide.

sections.title: Israel Strikes Hezbollah; Iran Air Defenses Active
sections.body: Israeli airstrikes targeted Hezbollah's Radwan Force in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley, striking dozens of rockets and launchers at a training camp 25 kilometers north of the border near Ayn al-Tina. Iran experienced widespread missile launches from Tang-e Kenesht and Konesht Canyon in Kermanshah Province, along with UAV activity over Jask, Hormozgan, and Shiraz, Fars. Air defense activity was recorded at Ramhormoz and the 45th Brigade base in Shushtar, Khuzestan Province, while missile launch sounds were heard in Ramshir and a UAV launched from Omidiyeh. An Israeli strike in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah killed Hamas deputy education minister Khaled Abu Nada and his wife; Israel said he managed Hamas banks and investment networks.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's simultaneous missile launches from Kermanshah and widespread UAV activity across Hormozgan, Fars, and Khuzestan indicate heightened readiness or testing of integrated air defense and offensive capabilities. Israeli strikes on Hezbollah's Radwan Force 25 kilometers from the border degrade precision strike capacity but risk escalation due to target depth. Russia's relocation of strategic bombers to Engels and preparation of Tu-95MS aircraft signal an imminent large-scale strike on Ukrainian critical infrastructure.
